scope: Public Google authorization-start repair for the current personal schedule site.

repair.observed_defect: The direct Google route first relied on sign-in page hydration before starting authorization.
repair.new_behavior: The canonical direct route invokes the existing Better Auth social sign-in handler, validates the Google authorization host, forwards the secure state cookie, and redirects to the returned authorization URL.
repair.retired_domain_behavior: The retired host redirects to canonical /auth/google before authorization so the state cookie belongs to the registered callback host.

not_proven: A completed Google account selection and callback on Version 128.
A completed email registration, verification, reset, and sign-in replay on Version 128.
Current Version 128 A/B tenant isolation or physical second-device history readback.
